text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japan Dirt Derby. Smart 
Falcon showed confidence in her specialty: 
the dirt track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, unlike the underground walkway 
before the Satsuki Sho, which was brimming 
with hope, today many of the faces there 
carried a fierce, intense glint.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Those who couldn't win on turf. Those who 
lacked the ability to even try. Some take 
on the dirt driven by the desperation of 
having nowhere left to go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume around her challenge with 
the desperate intensity of being "pushed 
to the edge." Smart Falcon heads to the 
race, ready to swallow up all that fierce 
determination.
